people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
translations.bsb: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”
translations.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
translations.asv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who died? and the prophets died: whom makest thou thyself?
